review:
Smokey as a leprechaun on a 6x5 cluster grid. When the special symbol is part of a win, its spot becomes a x2 position multiplier, and every later win there doubles it again – up to x100. Several in one win multiply together.

On top of that, Rainbows trigger Golden Square reveals like the other Le games, and the bonuses add a Lucky Charm Bar for extra spins and multipliers. The top bonus lands an Epic Rainbow every spin. 15,000x max and a big 97.52% top RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.52% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.31% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
